subject: math

objective.text: Subtract multi-digit numbers with the standard algorithm, regrouping once. Solve word problems with tape diagrams.

explanations.title: Are we ready to subtract?
explanations.text: Look across the top number from right to left. Check that each column has enough units to subtract the bottom number.

explanations.title: Unbundle a larger unit
explanations.text: If a column lacks units, unbundle 1 unit from the column on the left. It becomes 10 of this unit. Rename both numbers.

explanations.title: Subtract and name units
explanations.text: When every column is ready, subtract from right to left. Name the units as you go.

explanations.title: Check by adding
explanations.text: To check a subtraction, add the difference to the part you subtracted. The sum should be the whole.

explanations.title: Tape diagram for subtraction
explanations.text: The whole is the long tape. The known part and the unknown part are under it. A letter marks the unknown part.

examples.title: 4,259 minus 2,171
examples.text: The tens column has 5 tens, which is not enough for 7 tens. Unbundle 1 hundred into 10 tens to get 15 tens. 15 tens minus 7 tens is 8 tens. The answer is 2,088.

examples.title: 23,422 minus 11,510
examples.text: The hundreds column has 4 hundreds, which is not enough for 5. Unbundle 1 thousand into 10 hundreds to get 14 hundreds. The answer is 11,912.

examples.title: Boxes of paper
examples.text: 73,658 minus 8,052 is P. P is 65,606. 65,606 boxes remain.

assets_required.description: A vertical subtraction with place value columns up to hundred thousands. The child checks each column, unbundles when needed, subtracts, and checks by adding.
must_show_exactly: Columns in order: hundred thousands, ten thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens, ones
A top number and a bottom number lined up
A ready check for each column
Unbundling: 1 unit moves from the column on the left and becomes 10 in this column
A tape diagram with the whole, the known part and a variable for the unknown part
A check row that adds the difference and the known part
assets_required.interaction: Child checks each column, unbundles when a column is not ready, then subtracts and checks by adding.
assets_required.alt_text: A vertical subtraction problem with unbundling and a tape diagram.
